privateAi.title: Decisions happen in private AI chats

home.chatAnswer: Yes: one database, fewer moving parts to operate…
home.stepsTitle: Connect your tools once, then ask Leon what they contain.
home.stepsLead: Leon syncs every 15 minutes and stores each item verbatim. Your team keeps working in the tools it already uses.
home.step1Text: OAuth or an API key, across {count} connectors. The browser extension and a coding-assistant hook bring in AI conversations.
home.step2Text: Stored verbatim, with a deep link back to the source. AI conversations stay private to their author. Credentials and tokens are redacted before storage.
home.step2Quote: “We can commit to November 15 for V2…”
home.step3Text: From search, chat, or your AI assistant over MCP. Each sentence of the answer links to its source.
home.layersTitle: Every query passes through three layers, in this order.
home.layersLead: Leon never rewrites your data. It stores the originals, indexes them for hybrid search, and enforces permissions before anything is ranked.
home.useCasesTitle: Six teams search the same index for different answers.
home.useCasesLead: Leadership, sales, support, product, project managers and new hires search the same tools for different things.
home.proofLead: An unsourced answer is worthless the moment a client disputes it. Leon shows where every sentence comes from, and stops when the record runs out.
home.proofUnknown: **I don’t know.** No source on record mentions a price agreed with Verlant in 2024.

raw.title: The original text, opened in its own tool
raw.text: Leon stores what was written verbatim, and every citation opens the meeting, ticket or email where it was written.
